3.name: Celestial Spells
3.notes:
You always have the following spells prepared at the listed Warlock levels:

3rd: Aid, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, Light, Sacred Flame
5th: Daylight, Revivify
7th: Guardian of Faith, Wall of Fire
9th: Greater Restoration, Summon Celestial

3.name: Healing Light
3.notes: You gain a pool of d6s equal to 1 + your Warlock level. As a Bonus Action, you can heal a creature within 60 feet by spending dice (maximum spent at once = your Charisma modifier, minimum 1). Roll the spent dice and restore HP equal to the total. All dice are restored after a Long Rest.

6.name: Radiant Soul
6.notes:
You have Resistance to Radiant damage.
Once per turn, when a spell you cast deals Radiant or Fire damage, you can add your Charisma modifier to the damage dealt to one target of the spell.

10.name: Celestial Resilience
10.notes:
Whenever you use Magical Cunning or finish a Short or Long Rest, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Warlock level + your Charisma modifier.
You may also choose up to five creatures you can see; each gains Temporary Hit Points equal to half your Warlock level + your Charisma modifier.

14.name: Searing Vengeance
14.notes:
When you or an ally within 60 feet is about to make a Death Saving Throw, the creature regains HP equal to half its Hit Point maximum and can end the Prone condition.
Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of that creature takes 2d8 + your Charisma modifier Radiant damage and is Blinded until the end of the current turn.

Once used, this feature recharges on a Long Rest.
